claims.text: TrialGPT is an end-to-end framework for zero-shot patient-to-trial matching using large language models.
TrialGPT-Retrieval can recall over 90% of relevant trials using less than 6% of the initial collection.
TrialGPT-Matching achieves an accuracy of 87.3% on criterion-level patient eligibility prediction.
TrialGPT-Ranking scores are highly correlated with human judgments.
TrialGPT-Ranking scores outperform best-competing models by 43.8% in ranking and excluding trials.
TrialGPT reduces screening time by 42.6% in patient recruitment.

evidence.description: We introduce TrialGPT, an end-to-end framework for zero-shot patient-to-trial matching with large language models.
TrialGPT-Retrieval can recall over 90% of relevant trials using less than 6% of the initial collection.
Manual evaluations on 1015 patient-criterion pairs show that TrialGPT-Matching achieves an accuracy of 87.3% with faithful explanations, close to the expert performance.
The TrialGPT-Ranking scores are highly correlated with human judgments and outperform the best-competing models by 43.8% in ranking and excluding trials.

methodologies.name: TrialGPT
methodologies.description: An end-to-end framework for zero-shot patient-to-trial matching comprising candidate trial retrieval (TrialGPT-Retrieval), criterion-level patient eligibility prediction (TrialGPT-Matching), and trial-level scoring (TrialGPT-Ranking).
datasets: three cohorts of 183 synthetic patients with over 75,000 trial annotations
conditions: user study for screening time evaluation

limitations.text: Patient recruitment is challenging for clinical trials.
